h3: What Is a Permanent Passport-Style Booth?
h4: Always-on photo booth installations designed for repeat use, branding, and long-term engagement.

A permanent passport-style booth is a fixed, self-contained photo booth installed directly within a venue. Guests step inside, follow a familiar photo-capture flow, and receive their images instantly. Unlike traditional coin-operated booths, 36ixty installations are designed to operate continuously and integrate branding, digital sharing, and optional AI features.

Each permanent booth can be fully customised to align with the venue or brand, including exterior booth branding, vinyl wraps, on-screen UI branding, custom photo layouts, sponsor integration, and seasonal or campaign-led designs.

Permanent installations can be upgraded with AI-powered creative layers such as stylised photo outputs, creative transformations, themed visuals, campaign-led AI experiences, and seasonal content packs.
Installations can include instant digital sharing via QR code or link, optional GDPR-compliant guest email capture, usage and engagement tracking, and campaign performance insights.
